links.note: Drying clothes, mopped floors and sweat are 32732's own everyday instances of evaporation.
Sanitiser evaporating off the hands is one of 32743's cooling-effect examples.
Freezing named - 32740, the concept that gives both conversions.
Evaporation cooling its surroundings is the mechanism section 8.6 explains through the matka - 32743.
Sun against shade is Activity 8.8 in 32742.
Wind speeding evaporation - the second condition established in 32742.
Slow drying on a humid day - the condition 32742 singles out as the counter-intuitive one.
Sprinkling water on floor or roof in summer is given in 32743 as another instance of the cooling effect, next to the matka.
Humidity's effect on the rate of evaporation - 32742's rainy-day case. 32736 defines humidity but does not tie it to the drying rate.
